name: Glaze Guide
summary: Passive target-owned collection of named glaze samples with optional explicitly featured reference detail and no neutral selection model.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named native section when a visible title is supplied; otherwise a semantically neutral container. Omitted when the required samples composition is absent or empty.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional header emitted only with a visible title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading and section label when supplied.

anatomy.name: collection
anatomy.description: Native unordered list of complete target-owned passive glaze samples.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing exactly one direct passive sample figure.

anatomy.name: sample
anatomy.description: Passive native figure combining one visual sample with its visible textual identity.

anatomy.name: sampleVisual
anatomy.description: Target-provided visual sample; textual identity remains required and image alternatives depend on context.

anatomy.name: sampleCaption
anatomy.description: Native figure caption containing the required name and optional code.

anatomy.name: sampleName
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible glaze name; never replaced by color alone.

anatomy.name: sampleCode
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted identifier with no universal glaze-code schema implied.

anatomy.name: detail
anatomy.description: Optional passive native article named as explicitly featured or reference content; never implicitly selected.

anatomy.name: detailImage
anatomy.description: Optional target media with context-appropriate alternative text.

anatomy.name: detailInfo
anatomy.description: Detail text-content wrapper when a detail article is supplied.

anatomy.name: detailName
anatomy.description: Required visible contextual heading that names the optional detail article.

anatomy.name: detailMetadata
anatomy.description: Optional native description list of target-authored facts.

anatomy.name: detailMetadataGroup
anatomy.description: One complete target-authored term/value group; no vocabulary, units, or claims are prescribed.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic collection and detail layout governed by the actual host width.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive document presentation with no neutral selection, focus, hover, or synchronization state.

behavior.name: semanticRoot
attributes: aria-labelledby only when the visible title is present
behavior.description: A visible title produces a named native section; without a title the composition uses a generic div and emits no dangling labelling relationship.

behavior.name: nonEmptySamples
behavior.description: The required swatches slot must provide at least one complete sample with a stable key, visual, and non-empty visible name; otherwise the complete R2 root is omitted.

behavior.name: passiveSamples
behavior.description: Neutral samples are passive figures with no root role, tabindex, event, hover state, selection, destination, or form value.

behavior.name: targetSelectionBoundary
behavior.description: The legacy selected selector remains a CSS projection hook under ADR 0083, not a neutral behavior contract. A selectable target must compose canonical Radio or another explicitly accepted complete widget pattern, state, keyboard model, events, and synchronization rather than copying the passive figure or button-plus-aria-selected fixture.

behavior.name: sampleAlternatives
behavior.description: Targets keep a visible textual name and provide a useful alternative when the visual conveys additional appearance information; decorative or redundant image media uses alt="".

behavior.name: featuredDetail
behavior.description: Optional detail is a separately named passive article with complete native term/value groups. It is explicitly featured/reference content and is not synchronized, selected, or announced by neutral R2.

behavior.name: targetOwnedRecords
behavior.description: Targets own glaze records, source order, formulas, facts, claims, localization, media, mappings, accuracy, freshness, and lifecycle; the neutral contract defines only durable composition.

behavior.name: zeroRuntime
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no listener, observer, timer, request, selection store, filter, navigation, detail synchronization, live announcement, or target service.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional visible contextual heading; its presence selects named-section semantics.

properties.name: swatches
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned native passive sample collection; no record schema or widget role is implied.

properties.name: detail
properties.description: Optional explicitly featured/reference passive detail article; no selected relationship or synchronization is implied.

accessibility: Use a contextual visible heading when R2 should be a document section; title-absent compositions remain generic and emit no broken label reference.
Render a native unordered list with one direct list item and one passive native figure per complete glaze sample.
Keep every sample's required visible name and essential facts available as text; never rely on hue, finish, texture, imagery, or code alone.
Give informative sample/detail media context-specific alternatives and decorative or redundant image media alt="".
Name optional detail articles from their visible contextual heading and use complete native term/value groups for supplied facts.
Do not add grid, listbox, option, radio, button, tabindex, selected state, roving focus, or live announcements to the passive neutral collection.

If a target makes samples mutually exclusive controls, compose canonical Radio/native radios and implement the full labelled group, checked state, keyboard, event, disabled/required, validation, and detail-update contract.

web.notes: Native conditional section/div, list/item/figure composition, optional named reference article/description list, intrinsic CSS, and zero R2 JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Requires approved record source, editor schema, passive versus selectable use, product-option mapping, claim policy, ordering/limits, localization, and first template consumer.
